All tests pass now. The fix was to move the accessed key to the end of `order` in the `get()` method, which marks it as recently used. This ensures that when a new item is added (or an existing one updated), if the cache is at capacity, the oldest item (at the beginning of the order list) will be evicted instead of a recently accessed item.
